### Preprocessing

```{r}
set.seed(110122)
source('4bpreprocessing.R')
load('../data/claims-raw.RData')
```

```{r}
claims_clean <- claims_raw %>%
  parse_data() %>%
  add_tokens() 

claims_model <- claims_clean %>%
  select(.id, bclass, mclass, tokens)

save(claims_model, file = '../data/4b-cleaned-data.RData')
```

```{r}
#testing
nrow(claims_raw); nrow(claims_model)
anyDuplicated(claims_model$.id)             # should be 0
sum(claims_model$tokens == '')              # pages with no tokens
claims_model$tokens[1] %>% str_sub(1, 300)  # look at one page
```

### Linear Support Vector Machine

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(textrecipes)
```

```{r}
set.seed(110122)
# load cleaned data
load('../data/4b-cleaned-data.RData')
partitions <- claims_model %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8, strata = mclass)

train_df <- training(partitions)
test_df  <- testing(partitions)
```

```{r}
make_wf <- function(target, data){
  
  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, '~ tokens')), data = data) %>%
    step_tokenize(tokens, token = 'regex',
                  options = list(pattern = '\\s+')) %>%
    step_tokenfilter(tokens, min_times = 3, max_tokens = 10000) %>%
    step_tfidf(tokens, norm = 'l2', sublinear_tf = TRUE)
  
  # L2-regularized linear SVM; multiclass is one-vs-rest
  spec <- svm_linear(cost = tune()) %>%
    set_mode('classification') %>%
    set_engine('LiblineaR')
  
  workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(spec)
}
```

#### 5-fold stratified CV, tuning cost

```{r}
cost_grid   <- tibble(cost = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10, 30))
svm_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, f_meas)

set.seed(110122)
folds_m <- train_df %>%
  mutate(.y = mclass) %>%
  vfold_cv(v = 5, strata = .y)

wf_m <- make_wf('mclass', train_df)

tune_m <- tune_grid(wf_m,
                    resamples = folds_m,
                    grid      = cost_grid,
                    metrics   = svm_metrics)

collect_metrics(tune_m)
autoplot(tune_m)
```

```{r}
best_m <- select_best(tune_m, metric = 'accuracy')
```

### Final Model

```{r}
fit_m <- last_fit(finalize_workflow(wf_m, best_m),
                  split = partitions, metrics = svm_metrics)


```

```{r}
final_fit <- extract_workflow(fit_m)
saveRDS(final_fit, '../results/4b-svm-multiclass.rds')
```

### Test Metrics

```{r}
ho_preds <- collect_predictions(fit_m)

report_metrics <- function(truth, pred){
  tbl <- table(truth = truth, pred = factor(pred, levels = levels(truth)))
  N  <- sum(tbl)
  tp <- diag(tbl)
  fn <- rowSums(tbl) - tp
  fp <- colSums(tbl) - tp
  tn <- N - tp - fn - fp
  
  sens <- tp / (tp + fn)            # classwise accuracy (recall)
  spec <- tn / (tn + fp)
  prec <- tp / (tp + fp)            # NaN if a class is never predicted
  f1   <- 2 * prec * sens / (prec + sens)
  
  list(
    table = tbl,
    by_class = tibble(class = rownames(tbl), n = as.integer(rowSums(tbl)),
                      sensitivity = sens, specificity = spec,
                      precision = prec, f1 = f1),
    summary = tibble(accuracy          = sum(tp) / N,
                     sensitivity_macro = mean(sens),
                     specificity_macro = mean(spec),
                     f1_macro          = mean(replace_na(f1, 0)))
  )
}

ho_metrics <- report_metrics(ho_preds$mclass, ho_preds$.pred_class)

# shorter labels for display; check the order matches the factor levels
short_labels <- c("N/A", "Physical", "Fatality", "Unlawful", "Other")
stopifnot(length(short_labels) == nlevels(ho_preds$mclass))
levels(ho_preds$mclass)   # must line up with short_labels

# confusion matrix
display_tbl <- ho_metrics$table
dimnames(display_tbl) <- list(truth = short_labels, pred = short_labels)
display_tbl

# per-class table (%), plus macro average row
pct <- function(x) round(x * 100, 1)

metric_tbl <- ho_metrics$by_class %>%
  mutate(class = short_labels) %>%
  transmute(Class = class, Observations = n,
            `Sensitivity (%)` = pct(sensitivity),
            `Specificity (%)` = pct(specificity)) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(Class = "Macro average",
                   Observations = sum(ho_metrics$by_class$n),
                   `Sensitivity (%)` = pct(ho_metrics$summary$sensitivity_macro),
                   `Specificity (%)` = pct(ho_metrics$summary$specificity_macro)))
metric_tbl

# overall accuracy (%)
pct(ho_metrics$summary$accuracy)
```

### Predictions for claims-test.RData

```{r}
load('../data/claims-test.RData')
```

```{r}
test_ids   <- claims_test$.id
test_clean <- claims_test %>% parse_data() %>% add_tokens()

pred_m <- tibble(
  .id         = test_clean$.id,
  mclass.pred = predict(final_fit, test_clean)$.pred_class
)

# pages removed by the '<!' filter in parse_data() still get a prediction
# (majority class in the training data) so there is one row per test id
majority <- names(which.max(table(claims_model$mclass)))

pred_df <- tibble(.id = test_ids) %>%
  left_join(pred_m, by = '.id') %>%
  mutate(mclass.pred = coalesce(
    mclass.pred,
    factor(majority, levels = levels(claims_model$mclass)))) %>%
  select(.id, mclass.pred)

stopifnot(nrow(pred_df) == length(test_ids),
          !anyNA(pred_df$mclass.pred))

pred_df
table(pred_df$mclass.pred)

save(pred_df, file = '../results/4b-mclass-preds.RData')
```
